During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]], alongside the native [[Sessehshellah]], '''sabotaged''' an [[Imperial power station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]]. The team entered through the station's [[Water/Legends|water]] cooling circulation system, sabotaging the facility and stealing a [[comm unit scrambler]]. With the scrambler, the Alliance and Sessehshellah were able to plan and execute a [[Sabotage of an Imperial hydrocarbon refinery|mission]] to take out the [[Imperial hydrocarbon refinery]] on the planet.<ref name="Bright Water" />
